_readme: Controls the in-app rating/feedback modal for CV & PDF Editor. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and ignored by the app. Any field you delete falls back to the built-in default baked into the app. Changes go live without an app release, but jsDelivr needs a few minutes to refresh.
_enabled: Master switch. false hides the feedback modal everywhere, both on launch and after export. Use this to kill the prompt in production.
_showOnLaunch: Show the modal shortly after the app opens. false = only ever ask right after an export.
_showOnExport: Show the modal right after the user exports a resume or cover letter PDF. false = only ever ask on launch.
_requireExport: true = never ask until the user has exported at least one PDF. Set false to also ask users who have not exported anything yet.
_gapMinutes: Minimum minutes between two showings of the modal. Stops it reappearing when a user dismisses it, kills the app and immediately reopens. The clock starts the moment the modal appears, not when it is closed.
_launchDelayMs: Milliseconds to wait after app launch before showing the modal, so ads, analytics and the update check settle first. 4000 = 4 seconds.
_maxShows: Stop asking after this many showings, counted across the whole install. 0 = ask forever until the user rates. Example: 3 means a user who keeps dismissing is asked 3 times and then left alone.
_title: Headline text at the top of the modal.
title: Enjoying CV Editor?
_subtitle: Smaller line under the headline, above the star row.
subtitle: How would you rate your experience?
_notAffected: Two rules are hardcoded and cannot be changed from here: (1) once a user submits feedback or taps through to the Play Store the modal never shows again, and (2) the modal never stacks on top of the app-update modal.
